messages:
Alyssa (CS): Heads up — auth token exchange is failing for a subset of onboarding tenants (12) starting 03:10 UTC. Error spikes in logs: `token_exchange_timeout` and `401`. We have a partial mitigation but need customer comms + credit plan. Who can own outreach?
Jordan (CS Ops): Can you paste affected tenants & severity? high-touch vs trial?
Alyssa (CS): Affected list: tenant ids: T-9492, T-6671, T-3344, T-8890, T-2244, T-9901, T-5511, T-4200, T-7812, T-3102, T-6005, T-1122. 3 flagged as high-touch (T-9492, T-6671, T-3344).
Priya (AE): I'll take the 3 high-touch accounts. For renewals: T-9492 is in final quarter; please craft exec note.
Lee (Engineering): Root cause preliminary: our OAuth token refresh upstream to the identity provider times out under load due to malformed retry behavior when IdP returns 429. Quick mitigation: fallback to cached refresh token path — deploying in 15m. Permanent fix: tighten retry/backoff + circuit-breaker; ETA 48h.
incident-bot: Deploy started: rel/patch/fallback-token-path by Lee — build 1983 — 03:25 UTC.
Jordan (CS Ops): Draft customer note idea: short apology, what happened (auth refresh failures), who affected, immediate mitigation (we deployed fallback), ETA for full fix (48h), offer office hours & credits, link to status page and RCA follow-up.
Alyssa (CS): Draft for customers (short): "Hi — we recently saw intermittent failures during account onboarding that prevented token exchange with IdP, impacting some signups. We deployed a fallback that restores onboarding flows; full fix in progress. We're sorry for the disruption. We're scheduling office hours and will follow with an RCA and a credit for the disruption — details below." Thoughts?
Priya (AE): Suggest swapping 'signups' -> 'onboarding' and call out whether data was affected (say 'no data loss'). Also be explicit about next steps for high-touch customers: we'll do a health check and a live session.
Alyssa (CS): Updated customer snippet: "...restores onboarding flows; there was no account data loss. We'll reach out to schedule a live troubleshooting session and share a full RCA. As a gesture, we'll apply a one-week service credit or equivalent account credit."
Matt (Head of CS): Approve credit ask. For high-touch, include apology call + 2-week priority office hours. Sales/AE to own renewal messaging.
Jordan (CS Ops): Operational next steps: 1) Alyssa to send the short note to all 12 tenants 30m after this thread; 2) Priya to handle the 3 high-touch accounts with custom outreach; 3) Lee to post RCA in 48h and confirm fix on status.redwood.ai/incidents/3718; 4) CS to tag accounts for billing credit.
Alyssa (CS): I'll send the note at 04:00 UTC, create a shared doc with the final message & per-tenant notes, and mark tickets for billing.
Lee (Engineering): Patch deployed, rollout 80% in 10m. Monitoring for `token_exchange_success` metric increasing.
incident-bot: Monitoring alert cleared for token_exchange_timeout at 03:44 UTC.
Priya (AE): I'll contact T-9492 + T-6671 now, scheduling call with eng if needed.
Alyssa (CS): Thanks team. Please add any edits to the shared doc: /docs/cs/outreach/3718004321-onboard-sso-comm (private). We'll keep this thread for live updates only. :thumbsup:
